# Native PDF validation

`reports-pdf.test.ts` validates generated bytes with an independent PDFDocument
reload, metadata, pagination, report write contract, input/text/page bounds, and
missing-glyph behavior. The renderer uses pdf-lib plus its fontkit fork; all
runtime layout and PDF generation are JavaScript. No Python, Chromium, or remote
rendering service is involved.

Layout intentionally differs from upstream WeasyPrint. This is a searchable,
text-layout edition with bundled subset fonts, source values/citations, explicit
provider errors, and page numbers, rather than a full CSS renderer.

Default hard limits: 16 MiB HTML input, 300,000 extracted characters, 150 pages,
and 32 MiB output. Custom options can lower but not raise these bounds. Oversized
reports fail explicitly instead of silently truncating. Generated HTML's own
structured-data renderer also discloses its source-list/depth truncation.
